open_points.subject: Model M04 — ProjectViewerGrant duplicate active grant
open_points.text: “a second grant while the first is active is refused by the grant operation before any write” contradicts Carried changes: “the grant insert: a second grant for a pair that already has one surfaces as a persistence error”
open_points.question: When an active grant already exists, is the second grant rejected by the operation before insertion or attempted and surfaced as a persistence conflict?
open_points.default_guess: Pre-write operation refusal, because it is the newer specific rule.

witness.initial: Viewer V has an active ProjectViewerGrant for project P.
events: An administrator submits another grant of P to V.
outcomes: The grant operation detects the active record and refuses before attempting persistence.
The operation attempts insertion and reports the repository's uniqueness conflict.
witness.observer: The administrator calling the grant operation.

open_points.subject: Model M04 — ProjectViewerGrant rejected duplicate audit
open_points.text: “refused by the grant operation before any write” conflicts with M36: “every significant action … writes exactly one record,” including “viewer/grant/credential management” and rejected significant mutations.
open_points.question: Does “before any write” exclude only writing a ProjectViewerGrant, or does it also prohibit the required rejected AuditRecord?
options: No grant write, but one rejected AuditRecord is written
Neither the grant nor an AuditRecord is written
open_points.default_guess: Treat “write” as the grant write and record the rejected audit entry.

witness.initial: Viewer V already has an active grant for project P.
events: An administrator attempts to grant P to V again.
outcomes: No grant is inserted, but one rejected grant-management AuditRecord is appended.
The request is refused with no persisted write, including no AuditRecord.
witness.observer: An administrator or auditor reading the audit history.

set_aside.subject: R0-25 snapshot import capability-race rejection
set_aside.text: “a capability refused, between the route's check and the import is recorded as a rejection for that reason” has no matching ImportRejectReason in M20, whose closed catalog is “unsupported_contract_version, currency_mismatch, incomplete_content, unknown_project, archived_project, scope_denied, invalid_sections”; moreover M13 says producer capabilities are static per immutable source_type.
set_aside.question: Can capability authorization actually change between the two checks, and if it can, which required reject_reason represents the resulting SnapshotImportRecord?
options: The capability race is unreachable and should not be a recorded case
Add a distinct capability-denied rejection fact and a lifecycle event that can cause it
Represent capability refusal as scope_denied despite capability and scope being separate checks
set_aside.default_guess: Treat the capability-race case as unreachable because capabilities and source_type are immutable; principal disablement remains the separately specified no-record failure.
set_aside.unit: context: agreement of the earlier states' texts with this state
